compiled_state.title: [llm-review CI]: All reviewer agents hit ContextWindowExceededError -> exit 0 despite no valid review content
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
* **code_version:** 13183cd723133f898a3464d56936c8a487a76597
* **Scenario Type:** Observed in CI

#### Expected Behavior
When all reviewer agents fail with ContextWindowExceededError, the llm-review CI job should exit non-zero and block the PR — a review that produced no valid content cannot be treated as passing.

#### Actual Behavior
The llm-review job exits 0 even when every agent produced only synthetic `fallback_exhausted` findings and `scores: {}`, `summary: ""`. The framework emits WARNING: all N finding(s) are synthetic but still exits 0.

Observed in CI run 25538276056 job 74959367305: 5 agents (deep-correctness, deep-verification, deep-hygiene, test-quality, deep-arch) all hit 208K+ tokens > 200K limit. reviewer-findings.json had findings: [], scores: {}, summary: ''.

#### Root Cause Hypothesis
The CI runner script does not check whether all findings are synthetic (fallback_exhausted/parse_error/specialist_error) before exiting. The `WARNING: all N finding(s) are synthetic` message is logged but does not trigger a non-zero exit.

## Skills and Workflows
* plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py
* .github/workflows/ (llm-review job)
* plugins/dso/scripts/run-llm-review.sh or equivalent runner script

comments.body: Fixed: The bug was already resolved in commit 01b3e02 (fix: block PR when all findings are synthetic, a8f6-4c5e). At the bug's code_version (13183cd), the all-synthetic check in runner.py emitted a WARNING and returned 0; the fix changed it to emit ERROR and return 1. Added regression test test_runner_exits_1_when_all_agents_hit_context_window that exercises the full deep-tier scenario (5 agents all returning fallback_exhausted due to ContextWindowExceededError) and asserts exit 1.
